title: Annoying Villagers Full Dependencies Pack
description: A modpack containing only Annoying Villagers: Herobrine Invasion and its required dependencies, optional dependencies.
body: Annoying Villagers Full Dependencies Pack is a modpack with Annoying Villagers: Herobrine Invasion mod and all of it required dependencies and some optional dependencies. The modpack designed to resolve dependency problems when installing the core mod (Annoying Villagers: Herobrine Invasion). This modpack resolve the dependencies problem when installing Annoying Villagers: Herobrine Invasion mod, maintain the stability when playing with the mod. The core mod included in this mod is Annoying Villagers: Herobrine Invasion, which add tons of new weapons with unique abilitiy, Herobrine Bosses, game events and NPCs into your world, turn your game into a chaotic battle.
